name: Hundegger ROBOT-Drive
summary: Timber joinery machine whose patented 6-axis robot unit with tool changer saws, mills, drills and slots beams, glulam and CLT on all six sides in one pass, helped by an overhead 5-axis saw unit. Built by Hundegger in Hawangen, Germany, in 450, 650 and 1300 mm processing widths.

germany.statusNote: German maker; sold on request from its headquarters in Hawangen (Allgäu), with configuration agreed with Hundegger engineers before purchase. No price is published. A German contract-joinery firm near Munich runs one.

sellers.name: Hans Hundegger AG
sellers.note: Kemptener Straße 1, 87749 Hawangen, Germany. Service hotline +49 8332 9233 8000. Price on request.

specs.label: Timber cross-section
specs.conditions: ROBOT-Drive 1300; the 450 and 650 versions go up to 300 × 450 and 300 × 650 mm
specs.quote: Cross sections from 20 x 60 mm up to 300 x 1,300 mm

specs.label: Versions
specs.quote: The three basic versions of the ROBOT-Drive with different processing widths:

specs.label: Robot unit power
specs.quote: The ROBOT unit with a standard power rating of 12 kW and infinitely variable speed from 0 to 12,000 rpm caters for every need.

specs.label: Optional spindle
specs.quote: the robot unit can alternatively be equipped with a water-cooled 29 kW high-performance spindle with up to 15,000 rpm

specs.label: 5-axis saw/slot/marking unit
specs.conditions: overhead unit working in parallel with the robot
specs.quote: The overhead 5-axis saw/slot/marking unit with a drive rating of 13 kW further increases the throughput of the ROBOT-Drive.

specs.label: Sides machined per pass
specs.quote: 6-axis technology = processing on 6 sides in a single pass

specs.label: Timber length with automatic infeed
specs.conditions: at infeed and outfeed end; can be extended
specs.quote: with max. timber length of 10.00 m (at infeed and outfeed end)*

specs.label: Operations
specs.value: trimming, grooving, drilling, milling, slotting, marking
specs.quote: Trimming, grooving, drilling, milling, slotting or marking

notes: Stationary machine in the joinery hall; the 6-axis robot unit carries the machining spindle, so 'arm' here is the robot unit, not a gripper.
Options include drilling units, slot cutter, labelling system, short-part conveyor and automatic infeed with lift table.
Runs on Hundegger's CAMBIUM software, which links it with storage and feeding systems.
Uses: carpentry joinery, timber frame, log house, glulam and CLT joinery (maker).
